replies.author: Jahaj
replies.body:
Hey Jake,

Thanks for the report, but I highly doubt this is a hack, and even if it is, it is not game changing at all since our AFK timers were removed in the last update. In addition, he could have either left something on his space bar, or is holding it down for some reason. If you do see this person using any other hack listed under our illegal modifications, feel free to make another report, but for now this report is denied.

Regards,
Jahaj
